timingMeaning: Measured CPU-side renderer wall time; includes submission and driver waits, not GPU execution time.
geometryMeaning: Observed BufferBuilder vertices and estimated vertex data; alternative rendering pipelines may bypass these counters. Not GPU uploads or VRAM.
coverageMeaning: Measured standard entity/block entity renderer calls and attributed deferred Mekanism renderer calls. Flywheel instanced visual updates/draws and Create contraption virtual worlds are not covered; totals are not the complete cost of a mod.
percentiles: Capture percentiles use bounded histograms; averages include frames with zero calls.
